task: r10t1 - second independent relay instance, real 0->1 registration, t53, then restore the original binding
headline: Second independent instance is not possible with the current protocol without stopping the resident relay: a second dsh-eda-bridge of the same implementation exits before listening (even with --force), the editor gateway is hard-wired to 49630 while ?port= is metadata only, and t53 discovery always takes the first connected port (49620) and has no --port. No 0->1 registration was fabricated; the resident relay stayed true/count1 and t53 remained 5/5 on it.
whyBlocked: The second invocation never listens: findExistingInstance() sees the resident dsh-eda-bridge and exits 0 with 'Bridge server is already running on port 49620; no new instance started.' This happens without --force and also with --force; --force only bypasses a foreign implementation, not the same implementation.

The editor's built-in run-api-gateway dials the fixed ws://127.0.0.1:49630. A second HTTP instance on 49621 cannot bind 49630 because the resident instance owns it; the api/landing ?port= value is forwarded only as register metadata and does not change the dial target.

t53's HttpEasyEdaBridge.discover() scans 49620..49630 and returns the first bridge with edaConnected:true. The resident 49620 is connected, so t53 always selects it; there is no --port/--bridge option. If the first bridge is disconnected, discover() throws SCHEMATIC_BRIDGE_NO_EDA instead of continuing to 49621.
